briefing.headline: Mixed overnight moves as small caps swing wildly while mega‑caps show modest gains
briefing.summary: Core mega‑cap tech names posted small advances, with the Nasdaq‑linked QQQ up 0.33% and the broader SPY up 0.14%. Small‑cap and specialty tokens displayed extreme divergence, led by SMMT (+17.2%) and PRMB (+15.1%) on the upside and QURE (-59.7%) and ITG (-30.0%) on the downside. Advancers outnumbered decliners among the core set (8 vs 2), but the overall tape showed heightened volatility. Traders should note the lack of clear macro or company‑specific catalysts overnight.
